description: This file contains the implementation of a class that compiles Smarty template block plugins, specifically handling the code generation for block plugin execution including handling of open and close tags, attributes, and callback invocation.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Block_Plugin
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling Smarty block plugin code, managing plugin execution, attributes, and nested block structure during template compilation.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates the compiled PHP code for executing a Smarty block plugin, handling both opening and closing tags, attribute parsing, callback setup, and output buffering.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares the callback function and parameter array for the block plugin based on parsed attributes.
